cards.title: Real repo source: work-scoped token + exact SHA checkout
cards.acceptance: Given a repo URL + SHA + a work-scoped token (installation token, not PAT), `services/source/git.go` clones the repo into an isolated workspace, checks out the exact SHA, and returns a Cleanup() that removes the workspace. Token never appears in process env outside the git invocation. Unit tests cover checkout, cleanup, and SHA verification.
cards.notes: M1 card 2/8 (RFC-0003). SHIPPED in commit b424797 (M1 k-impl-019+020+025). 9/9 tests pass, clones JonasAbde/works-execution, verifies SHA matches expected.

cards.title: GitHub webhook receiver (HMAC verify + idempotent delivery)
cards.acceptance: POST /v1/webhook/github with valid HMAC-SHA256 (X-Hub-Signature-256) creates exactly one Work per (delivery_id, event). Invalid signature returns 401 and creates zero Works. Duplicate X-GitHub-Delivery is a no-op. Unit tests cover all 3 paths. Live test against a real webhook delivery works.
cards.notes: M1 card 1/8 (RFC-0003). SHIPPED: services/webhook/{github,github_test}.go (HMAC verify + parser, 13/13 tests) + services/api/{webhook_handler,webhook_handler_test}.go (HTTP routing, idempotency, source mapping, repo allow-list, 13/13 tests). Endpoints: POST /v1/webhook/github. HMAC-SHA256 verify against shared secret. Idempotency by X-GitHub-Delivery -> webhooks table (migration v6->v7). workgraph.Source extended with Branch/SHA/HTMLURL/CloneURL/PRNumber/PRAction/PRHead/PRBase. cmd/works-api gains -webhook-secret + -webhook-production-access flags (WORKS_WEBHOOK_SECRET env). Live smoke test against running works-api confirms: signed push -> 201 created + work_id, duplicate delivery -> 200 duplicate, bad sig -> 401, ping -> 200 ignored.

cards.title: Real runner: Go stack detect, run go vet + go test ./... -count=1
cards.acceptance: services/runner/real.go detects Go (go.mod), runs go vet + go test ./... -count=1, captures stdout+stderr, propagates exit code. Integration: SUCCEEDED on known-good, FAILED on known-bad.
cards.notes: M1 card 3/8. SHIPPED in commit b424797. 10/10 tests, runs real Go modules, captures pass/fail/vet-fail.

cards.title: GitHub Check Run publisher
cards.acceptance: services/publisher/check.go POSTs /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs with name=works-execution, head_sha, conclusion, details_url. Installation token. Idempotent on (head_sha, name).
cards.notes: M1 card 4/8. SHIPPED: services/publisher/ package with Publisher interface + StatusAPIPublisher (POST /repos/{o}/{r}/statuses/{sha}, works with PAT gho_*) + CheckRunPublisher (POST /repos/{o}/{r}/check-runs, requires GitHub App credentials). cmd/works-publisher binary (one-shot CLI, env-driven: WORKS_GITHUB_TOKEN for status mode, WORKS_GITHUB_APP_ID + WORKS_GITHUB_INSTALLATION_TOKEN_CMD for check-run mode). Hooked into services/api via services/api/publisher_hook.go: maybePublishOnTerminal fires on SUCCEEDED/FAILED when Work has Repository+SHA provenance, fire-and-forget goroutine, errors logged only. cmd/works-api auto-selects publisher kind from env. 13 unit tests green, 4 publisher-hook tests green. Actions-vs-WORKS comparison parked: requires Check Run publisher driving a real Actions workflow, which depends on the App credentials only Jonas can create.

cards.title: Chaos test: kill worker mid-build, replacement recovers
cards.acceptance: e2e/chaos_worker_loss_test.go: submit Work, kill worker via SIGKILL mid-exec, start replacement with same ID, assert (1) original attempt cancelled with reason, (2) new attempt starts+completes, (3) work reaches SUCCEEDED, (4) both attempts in audit log.
cards.notes: M1 card 5/8. SHIPPED in commit 841e5a8. PASS in 26.4s on real Go build, 2 attempts preserved in audit log.

cards.title: Benchmark: Actions vs WORKS (cold/warm/recovery) with JSON report
cards.acceptance: cmd/works-bench + services/bench for {Actions, WORKS subprocess, WORKS Docker} × {cold, warm, recovery} runs same work, writes docs/benchmarks/m1-*.md with queue_time, exec_time, wall_time, cpu_time, cache_hit_ratio, est_cost_usd, comparison table.
cards.notes: M1 card 6/8. SHIPPED: cmd/works-bench measures WORKS-subprocess vs WORKS-Docker end-to-end latency (cold + optional warm). Writes docs/benchmarks/m1-<ts>.{json,md} + 'latest' symlinks. 11 unit paths in package. End-to-end test confirmed: subprocess mean=3410ms, docker mean=3926ms (~500ms hermetic overhead). JSON includes per-iteration queue/exec/total latencies; markdown includes summary table. CLI: works-bench run --api=URL --iterations=N --out-dir=DIR --warm. Actions baseline still parked until App credentials enable Check Run publisher.

cards.title: Pilot UX: works connect github + works pilot <repo>
cards.acceptance: `works connect github` prints webhook URL+secret+perms, validates with ping. `works pilot <repo>` submits Work, polls for terminal state, prints timeline, exits 0 on success.
cards.notes: M1 card 7/8. SHIPPED: 'works connect github' prints the GitHub webhook checklist (URL + content-type + secret hint + recommended events + smoke-test curl + reachability probe). 'works pilot <owner/repo>' submits a CLI work for the repo OR (with --expect-webhook) watches for terminal work to appear via webhook. Polls every 1s, prints timeline, exits 0 on SUCCEEDED, 1 on FAILED/CANCELLED/timeout. End-to-end test against running works-api confirmed: POST 201 + state transition observed + status printed.

cards.notes: RFC-0004. Verified on prod VDS: wrkr_prod_1 in pool avc-core; own-pool work SUCCEEDED ~1s; foreign-pool work stays QUEUED with zero attempts (9x pool denied at grant); 26/26 packages green.

cards.title: Worker token renewal (transparent re-enroll on 401)

cards.notes: Fixed production token_expired outage. Verified: worker drains QUEUED backlog after expiry; CLI 401->enroll->201 flow.

cards.title: Content-addressed work cache (RFC-0005)
cards.acceptance: packages/cache: canonical fingerprint (run+source sha+env+reqs+scope, SHA-256); SQLite store refuses failed results; scheduler attaches cache_key to ready items; worker claims hit before executing (dur 0, cache:hit evidence) and stores successful misses; GET/PUT /v1/cache/{key} behind bearer.
cards.notes: RFC-0005. Verified live: cold pipeline 21s, warm all-hit 3s (7x). 5 unit tests + full cycle verified on prod.

cards.title: Self-hosted CI: works builds itself (RFC-0006)
cards.acceptance: works.yml pipeline (vet->test->build, pool avc-core, cache on vet); cmd/works-ci run/watch submits + waits + exits with verdict; evidence details carry error tail on failure; sandbox env gains Go toolchain (PATH/GOMODCACHE/GOPATH/GOCACHE under /var/lib/works); systemd worker override for repo write access.
cards.notes: Dogfood: works-execution CI runs on its own control plane, zero GitHub Actions. Verified live: PASS 21s cold -> 3s warm all-cache-hit. Failure diagnosability: evidence.details.error carries log tail.

cards.title: Webhook honors repo works.yml (pool, DAG, cache, triggers)
cards.acceptance: Webhook receiver fetches the repo's works.yml at the delivery SHA; honors requirements.pool, node DAG, cache flags; 200 ignored when event not in triggers; 502 on broken works.yml; falls back to single-node verify when no works.yml or no token. Verified live on prod: push on main -> 3-node DAG (vet/test/build) on pool avc-core -> SUCCEEDED -> GitHub status success.
cards.notes: PR #5 (dbd11a1, merged 2308ab1). Closes the gap where webhook-triggered CI ignored works.yml (no pool boundary, no cache) despite 'works onboard' promising it. Live proof: wrk_02653ca3d6c7339209c5432635750f12 SUCCEEDED, pool=avc-core, 3 nodes, GitHub status success on 2308ab1.

cards.title: Fix: persist runner heartbeat refresh (registry copy bug)
cards.acceptance: Re-registering a runner refreshes LastHeartbeatAt in the registry. Regression test RED on old code (heartbeat lost), GREEN on fix. Verified on prod: heartbeat live (1s old), cache hits (vet cache:hit 0ms) after fix.
cards.notes: PR #7 (merged f1925c4). Root cause: registerRunner mutated the copy from get() without put() back — heartbeat never refreshed, runner went stale after 30s, ready handler fell back to legacy path, pool routing (RFC-0004) AND cache fingerprinting (RFC-0005) silently disabled in prod. Observed: heartbeat frozen 20:55:56Z for hours, all CI evidence 'cache: disabled'. After fix: heartbeat 1s old, vet cache:hit 0ms.

cards.title: k-link-01: WORKS-Link server surface (/link/v1 pair|mounts|missions|revoke)
